oews_national_may2018.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
oews_national_may2018.soc_vintage: 2010 SOC (OEWS used the 2010 SOC through May 2018; May 2019 onward uses the 2018 SOC)
oews_national_may2018.why_this_year: matches the SOC-2010 codes in crosswalks/soc10_isco08.dta and the O*NET-SOC 2010 codes in the exposure files
oews_national_may2018.note: bls.gov returns a 1,325-byte 'Access Denied' page to a default curl/urllib user agent; crosswalks/bls2.xls and crosswalks/isco08_to_soc2010.xls are saved copies of that page. A descriptive user agent gets the file.
